name: html
rules: parse:whatwg-html13.2 (htmlparse); valid utf-8 parsed as is, other bytes decoded (bom, transport charset, meta prescan)
emit:one line per start tag, end tag and text run; no indentation; void elements without end tag
fixpoint:output re-parsed and re-emitted until stable (at most 4 rounds; trees that do not round trip)
drop:comments,processing-instructions
text:merge adjacent runs across dropped nodes; collapse ascii whitespace; trim; drop empty
text:escape & < >; attributes: escape & "
attrs:sort by qualified name (xlink:/xml:/xmlns: prefixes)
attr:class:sort and dedupe tokens
doctype:keep name and ids; quirks without ids gets an extra token to stay quirks
derived:inline script → #script-n (js, json for json/ld+json/importmap/speculationrules, text otherwise); body emptied
derived:inline style → #style-n (css); body emptied
derived:on* attributes and javascript: urls → #handlers (js); value → handler placeholder
element:plaintext → pre data-ff-plaintext
mask:nonce attribute → nonce
mask:input[name in csrf names].value, meta[name in csrf names].content → csrf
mask:input[type=hidden].value unless short numeric/boolean → hidden_value
mask:integrity attribute → build_hash
mask:url attributes (src href action data poster formaction srcset) → cache_bust query values, build_hash asset names
mask:data-* values that are timestamps/uuids/build ids, or whose name says time/nonce/token/request-id → timestamp/nonce/random_id
mask:text iso-8601 date-times → timestamp

name: js
rules: parse:ecma-262 15th ed. (jsparse) tolerant; script goal, module goal when only it parses cleanly
emit:jsparse readable printer (one statement per line, canonical spacing, double quotes, comments dropped); 'directives' re-quoted with "
fallback:on any diagnostic, line normalization (leading space dropped, inner and trailing space runs → one space, lf); grade partial
mask:string literals (not keys, not directives, no '/') that are timestamps/uuids/build ids → class placeholder string
mask:iso-8601 date-times inside string and template literals → timestamp
mask:13-digit epoch-millisecond numeric literals → timestamp identifier

name: css
rules: tokenize:css-syntax-3 §4 (cssparse); tokens re-emitted from their source text
drop:comments (a comment separates like white space)
space:white-space runs → one space; none next to { } ; , ) or after ( : and function tokens; none around ! and around > + ~ outside parentheses; none before a declaration colon
lines:newline after { ; } and before }; a ; directly before } or ; is dropped
string:re-quoted with " when the value needs no escape
url:url(value) without inner white space when the value needs no escape
invalid:strings cut by eof are closed; an escape cut by eof is dropped; a final hex escape gets its space; bad-string and bad-url tokens become fixed placeholders
mask:url values → cache_bust query values, build_hash asset names

name: json
rules: parse:rfc-8259 (diff.ParseJSON: numbers verbatim, duplicate keys rejected); an xssi )]}' first line is dropped
emit:canonical members sorted bytewise by key, two-space indentation, one scalar or bracket per line
string:escape " \ and controls (\b \f \n \r \t, else \u00xx); everything else raw utf-8
fallback:invalid json → text@1 line normalization; grade partial

mask:values of volatile keys (case and -_ insensitive: timestamp ts time servertime now generatedat buildtime builddate buildid nonce csrf csrftoken xsrf requestid traceid spanid correlationid rid) → class by key

name: xml
rules: parse:xml-1.0 5th ed. + namespaces (xmlparse); doctype subsets refused; gzip sitemaps inflated to 8 MiB
emit:one line per start tag, end tag, text run and processing instruction; empty elements as start-end pairs
attrs:namespace declarations first sorted by prefix, then attributes sorted by (namespace uri, local name)
drop:comments, xml declaration, doctype
text:cdata as text; collapse xml white space; trim; drop empty; escape & < > (attributes: & < " tab lf cr)
partial:a not-well-formed or limited read emits the partial tree with every open element closed

name: headers
rules: input:one "name: value" line per field (HeaderBlock); lines without ':' ignored
keep:security-relevant headers only (securityHeaders); they are level-3 paths, so no learned rule masks them
name:lower case; value: white-space runs → one space, trimmed
csp:directives lower-cased and sorted; sources sorted and deduped; 'nonce-…' sources removed → nonce
set-cookie:value dropped (name kept); attribute names lower-cased, sorted; expires dropped → timestamp
hsts:directives lower-cased and sorted
location:query values masked → random_id
order:lines sorted by (name, value)

name: text
rules: lines:cr lf and cr → lf; a utf-8 bom starting the first non-blank line dropped; trailing spaces and tabs trimmed
lines:runs of blank lines → one blank line; leading and trailing blank lines dropped; final lf
mask:iso-8601 date-times → timestamp
d2:ts, tsx and jsx are text; they are never handed to the js parser

name: binary
rules: emit:one line "binary sha256:<hex> size:<n>"; binary bodies are compared by hash only
